items.html: And behold, from there, BON, the entire feminine side of Atzilut is made, for Atik takes the tastes of BON to make his Nukva, which are the first five Sefirot in the Keter of BON, as known, for every Sefira contains ten. He also takes the GAR of the Sefira of Chochma, and the first four of the Bina of BON, all this for the Nukva; and he further takes for the aforementioned Nukva the seven Ketarim of the seven lower ones of BON. Arich takes the last five of the Keter of BON for the sake of the Nukva. Abba takes the seven lower ones of the Chochma of BON. Ima takes the six lower ones of the Bina of BON. And ZON take all seven lower ones of BON, except for the Ketarim in them, which Atik took.
